title: How Bullying Spreads and How to Stop It

cues.text: My talk begins where my life nearly ended.
cues.en: My talk begins where my life nearly ended.
cues.zh: 我的演講，要從我的人生 差點走到盡頭的時刻說起。

cues.text: In 2012, I stood in the red circle,
cues.en: In 2012, I stood in the red circle,
cues.zh: 2012 年，我站在 TED 講臺的紅點上，

cues.text: and I gave a TED talk on social psychology.
cues.en: and I gave a TED talk on social psychology.
cues.zh: 發表了一場關於 社會心理學的 TED 演講。

cues.text: I was a junior professor at Harvard,
cues.en: I was a junior professor at Harvard,
cues.zh: 當時我是哈佛大學的助理教授，

cues.text: and I spoke about feeling like an outsider.
cues.en: and I spoke about feeling like an outsider.
cues.zh: 我談到自己感覺像個局外人。

cues.text: I spoke about how we lift our self-confidence
cues.en: I spoke about how we lift our self-confidence
cues.zh: 我談到，我們如何提升自信，

cues.text: and how our bodies affect the way we feel.
cues.en: and how our bodies affect the way we feel.
cues.zh: 以及我們的身體如何影響自我的感受。

cues.text: The talk went viral online quickly
cues.en: The talk went viral online quickly
cues.zh: 那場演講很快就在網路上瘋傳，

cues.text: and became one of the most viewed TED talks of all time.
cues.en: and became one of the most viewed TED talks of all time.
cues.zh: 成為 TED 歷來 觀看次數最高的演講之一。

cues.text: And that cracked my world open.
cues.en: And that cracked my world open.
cues.zh: 那也讓我的世界徹底開啟了，

cues.text: In some beautiful ways.
cues.en: In some beautiful ways.
cues.zh: 在某些方面，那是非常美好的事。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）

cues.text: I saw the most luminous parts of people.
cues.en: I saw the most luminous parts of people.
cues.zh: 我看見了人性中最耀眼的一面。

cues.text: And then I saw the darkest parts.
cues.en: And then I saw the darkest parts.
cues.zh: 然後，我也看見了最黑暗的一面。

cues.text: When I became the target
cues.en: When I became the target
cues.zh: 因為後來，我成為 一場長期霸凌行動的目標。

cues.text: of a sustained bullying campaign.
cues.en: of a sustained bullying campaign.

cues.text: Not by trolls on the internet --
cues.en: Not by trolls on the internet --
cues.zh: 不是網路上的酸民——

cues.text: I learned to dismiss them quickly --
cues.en: I learned to dismiss them quickly --
cues.zh: 我很快就學會不把他們當一回事——

cues.text: but by colleagues,
cues.en: but by colleagues,
cues.zh: 而是我的同事、

cues.text: by tenured professors, department chairs
cues.en: by tenured professors, department chairs
cues.zh: 終身職教授、系主任

cues.text: and journal editors
cues.en: and journal editors
cues.zh: 和期刊編輯。

cues.text: who used their names -- their real names --
cues.en: who used their names -- their real names --
cues.zh: 他們用自己的名字——真實姓名——

cues.text: to attack me relentlessly,
cues.en: to attack me relentlessly,
cues.zh: 多年來持續毫不留情地攻擊我。

cues.text: for many years.
cues.en: for many years.
cues.zh: 他們公開宣稱，

cues.text: They publicly declared
cues.en: They publicly declared
cues.zh: 他們公開宣稱，

cues.text: that I had no serious conception of the term science.
cues.en: that I had no serious conception of the term science.
cues.zh: 我根本沒有真正理解 「科學」這個詞的意義。

cues.text: That what I'd proposed was stupid and unintuitive.
cues.en: That what I'd proposed was stupid and unintuitive.
cues.zh: 他們說，我提出的東西 很愚蠢，也違反直覺。

cues.text: That I'd abandoned academia
cues.en: That I'd abandoned academia
cues.zh: 他們說，我已經離棄學術界，

cues.text: for a lucrative career selling pseudoscience
cues.en: for a lucrative career selling pseudoscience
cues.zh: 轉而追求有利可圖的事業，

cues.text: to a mostly women audience.
cues.en: to a mostly women audience.
cues.zh: 向以女性為主的受眾兜售偽科學。

cues.text: They created a narrative about our work on power posing
cues.en: They created a narrative about our work on power posing
cues.zh: 他們還塑造出一種說法，

cues.text: that it had been debunked.
cues.en: that it had been debunked.
cues.zh: 但實情是：

cues.text: But here's the thing.
cues.en: But here's the thing.
cues.zh: 但實情是：

cues.text: Our work on power posing hadn't been debunked.
cues.en: Our work on power posing hadn't been debunked.
cues.zh: 我們「權力姿勢」的研究， 並沒有被推翻。

cues.text: In fact,
cues.en: In fact,
cues.zh: 事實上，

cues.text: the central finding, the most important finding,
cues.en: the central finding, the most important finding,
cues.zh: 我們最核心、也是最重要的發現，

cues.text: was that our posture,
cues.en: was that our posture,
cues.zh: 是我們的姿勢——

cues.text: how expansive or contractive it is,
cues.en: how expansive or contractive it is,
cues.zh: 也就是身體姿勢有多麼舒展或收縮——

cues.text: affects the way we feel,
cues.en: affects the way we feel,
cues.zh: 會影響我們的感受，

cues.text: how powerful  confident we feel.
cues.en: how powerful  confident we feel.
cues.zh: 影響我們覺得自己有多麼強大和自信。

cues.text: It was replicated dozens of times
cues.en: It was replicated dozens of times
cues.zh: 這項發現後來被世界各地的實驗室 以獨立研究的方式重複驗證了數十次，

cues.text: in independent studies by labs all over the world,
cues.en: in independent studies by labs all over the world,
cues.zh: 這項發現後來被世界各地的實驗室 以獨立研究的方式重複驗證了數十次，

cues.text: using better methods than those that we used,
cues.en: using better methods than those that we used,
cues.zh: 而且採用的方法 甚至比我們當初使用的更完善，

cues.text: and even by our skeptics.
cues.en: and even by our skeptics.
cues.zh: 連質疑我們的人也得出相同的結果。

cues.text: In multiple meta-analyses,
cues.en: In multiple meta-analyses,
cues.zh: 在多項統合分析中，

cues.text: including one with 88 studies in nearly 10,000 participants,
cues.en: including one with 88 studies in nearly 10,000 participants,
cues.zh: 包括一項涵蓋 88 項研究、 納入近萬名參與者的分析，

cues.text: they landed on the same conclusion:
cues.en: they landed on the same conclusion:
cues.zh: 都得出了相同的結論：

cues.text: Expansive versus contractive posture
cues.en: Expansive versus contractive posture
cues.zh: 身體姿勢是舒展還是收縮，

cues.text: affects how powerful or powerless we feel.
cues.en: affects how powerful or powerless we feel.
cues.zh: 會影響我們覺得自己有力量還是無力。

cues.text: The behaviors and the hormones were more complicated,
cues.en: The behaviors and the hormones were more complicated,
cues.zh: 至於行為和荷爾蒙的部分， 就複雜得多，

cues.text: and there were non-replications.
cues.en: and there were non-replications.
cues.zh: 也確實有一些研究 未能重現原先的結果。

cues.text: In the science that I was trained in
cues.en: In the science that I was trained in
cues.zh: 按照我敬愛的指導教授 教我的科學研究方式，

cues.text: by my dear advisor,
cues.en: by my dear advisor,
cues.zh: 按照我敬愛的指導教授 教我的科學研究方式，

cues.text: that would have led to constructive and friendly inquiries,
cues.en: that would have led to constructive and friendly inquiries,
cues.zh: 這本來應該促成建設性 而友善的探究與合作，

cues.text: collaborations, to figure out what was different about these studies.
cues.en: collaborations, to figure out what was different about these studies.
cues.zh: 讓我們一起找出這些研究的差異所在。

cues.text: Were there moderators
cues.en: Were there moderators
cues.zh: 是否存在某些調節因素，

cues.text: that affected why you got this effect and we got this effect?
cues.en: that affected why you got this effect and we got this effect?
cues.zh: 導致你們得到這樣的效果， 而我們得到的是另一種效果？

cues.text: Science should interrogate itself.
cues.en: Science should interrogate itself.
cues.zh: 科學應該受到檢驗。

cues.text: That is how knowledge advances --
cues.en: That is how knowledge advances --
cues.zh: 知識就是這樣進步的──

cues.text: that should happen.
cues.en: that should happen.
cues.zh: 理應如此。

cues.text: But that's not what happened in my case.
cues.en: But that's not what happened in my case.
cues.zh: 但我的情況並非如此。

cues.text: Science didn't interrogate itself.
cues.en: Science didn't interrogate itself.
cues.zh: 科學沒有得到檢驗，

cues.text: It stopped itself.
cues.en: It stopped itself.
cues.zh: 反而自我止步。

cues.text: And it silenced a scientist, a junior scientist,
cues.en: And it silenced a scientist, a junior scientist,
cues.zh: 它讓一位科學家—— 一位年輕的科學家——噤聲了。

cues.text: who also had a lot of other research
cues.en: who also had a lot of other research
cues.zh: 而這位科學家其實還有許多其他研究，

cues.text: on stereotyping and prejudice and intergroup relations.
cues.en: on stereotyping and prejudice and intergroup relations.
cues.zh: 研究主題包括刻板印象、 偏見以及群體間關係。

cues.text: Two tenured Ivy League professors
cues.en: Two tenured Ivy League professors
cues.zh: 兩位常春藤盟校的終身職教授

cues.text: told a "New York Times" reporter
cues.en: told a "New York Times" reporter
cues.zh: 告訴《紐約時報》記者，

cues.text: that they would have defended me publicly
cues.en: that they would have defended me publicly
cues.zh: 如果不是害怕自己也成為攻擊目標，

cues.text: had they not been afraid of becoming targets themselves.
cues.en: had they not been afraid of becoming targets themselves.
cues.zh: 他們本來會公開替我辯護。

cues.text: Friends wrote privately,
cues.en: Friends wrote privately,
cues.zh: 朋友私下寫信給我說：

cues.text: "I'm so sorry this is happening to you.
cues.en: "I'm so sorry this is happening to you.
cues.zh: 「我很遺憾你遇上這些事。

cues.text: These guys are horrible."
cues.en: These guys are horrible."
cues.zh: 這些人太可怕了。」

cues.text: But wouldn't look at me publicly.
cues.en: But wouldn't look at me publicly.
cues.zh: 但在公開場合，他們卻不願正眼看我。

cues.text: I couldn't eat,
cues.en: I couldn't eat,
cues.zh: 我吃不飯，

cues.text: I didn't sleep,
cues.en: I didn't sleep,
cues.zh: 睡不著覺。

cues.text: I worked all the time defending myself
cues.en: I worked all the time defending myself
cues.zh: 整天忙著應付接踵而至的攻擊，

cues.text: from constant incoming attacks,
cues.en: from constant incoming attacks,
cues.zh: 無休無止、毫不留情的攻擊。

cues.text: non-stop, relentless.
cues.en: non-stop, relentless.
cues.zh: 無休無止、毫不留情的攻擊。

cues.text: It was very hard to be present for my son and my husband.
cues.en: It was very hard to be present for my son and my husband.
cues.zh: 我很難專注陪伴我的兒子和丈夫。

cues.text: I'm sorry.
cues.en: I'm sorry.
cues.zh: 對不起。

cues.text: And I chose to walk away from my job at Harvard
cues.en: And I chose to walk away from my job at Harvard
cues.zh: 最後，我選擇離開哈佛的工作，

cues.text: a year before going up for tenure.
cues.en: a year before going up for tenure.
cues.zh: 那時距離我爭取終身職只剩一年。

cues.text: Not because I was forced to,
cues.en: Not because I was forced to,
cues.zh: 不是因為有人逼我離開，

cues.text: but because I knew that staying meant certain death.
cues.en: but because I knew that staying meant certain death.
cues.zh: 而是因為我知道， 留下來就等於自尋死路。

cues.text: And so ...
cues.en: And so ...
cues.zh: 於是……

cues.text: Eventually,
cues.en: Eventually,
cues.zh: 最後，

cues.text: I tried to take my own life twice,
cues.en: I tried to take my own life twice,
cues.zh: 我曾經兩次試圖自殺，

cues.text: because this kind of bullying
cues.en: because this kind of bullying
cues.zh: 因為這種霸凌同時具有 兩種可怕的面貌：

cues.text: is simultaneously this horrible public spectacle
cues.en: is simultaneously this horrible public spectacle
cues.zh: 一方面是一場公開羞辱的巨大鬧劇，

cues.text: of shame where you're in a spotlight.
cues.en: of shame where you're in a spotlight.
cues.zh: 讓你被聚光燈照得無所遁形；

cues.text: And at the same time,
cues.en: And at the same time,
cues.zh: 另一方面，

cues.text: it's a total erasure of who you are
cues.en: it's a total erasure of who you are
cues.zh: 它又徹底抹去你的身分，

cues.text: and what you've done.
cues.en: and what you've done.
cues.zh: 以及你過往的成就。

cues.text: Many targets don't survive.
cues.en: Many targets don't survive.
cues.zh: 很多成為霸凌目標的人， 最後都沒能活下來。

cues.text: And I do want to say, before I go forward, to the targets:
cues.en: And I do want to say, before I go forward, to the targets:
cues.zh: 在我繼續說下去之前， 我想先對那些成為目標的人說：

cues.text: I understand.
cues.en: I understand.
cues.zh: 我瞭解。

cues.text: I see you, and I know that what seems incredible --
cues.en: I see you, and I know that what seems incredible --
cues.zh: 我懂你，我知道那些 看似不可思議的事——

cues.text: happened.
cues.en: happened.
cues.zh: 確實發生了。

cues.text: But.
cues.en: But.
cues.zh: 但是，

cues.text: This is not a talk about despair.
cues.en: This is not a talk about despair.
cues.zh: 這個演講不是要談絕望。

cues.text: This is a talk about earned hope.
cues.en: This is a talk about earned hope.
cues.zh: 我想談的是「得來不易的希望」。

cues.text: I've been a social psychologist for 25 years,
cues.en: I've been a social psychologist for 25 years,
cues.zh: 我從事社會心理學研究已有 25 年，

cues.text: studying the forces that affect how we treat each other and judge each other.
cues.en: studying the forces that affect how we treat each other and judge each other.
cues.zh: 研究影響我們彼此相待和 評判方式的種種因素。

cues.text: But I've spent the last eight
cues.en: But I've spent the last eight
cues.zh: 但過去八年，

cues.text: focused on how cruelty becomes collective.
cues.en: focused on how cruelty becomes collective.
cues.zh: 我一直專注研究， 殘酷如何成為集體行為，

cues.text: How truth becomes distorted.
cues.en: How truth becomes distorted.
cues.zh: 真相如何被扭曲，

cues.text: How people decide that one person should be pushed out of the group.
cues.en: How people decide that one person should be pushed out of the group.
cues.zh: 人們如何決定要把某個人逐出群體。

cues.text: But also, more importantly,
cues.en: But also, more importantly,
cues.zh: 但更重要的是，

cues.text: what are the things that we can do
cues.en: what are the things that we can do
cues.zh: 我們能做些什麼，

cues.text: to prevent those cultures from taking hold before they harden.
cues.en: to prevent those cultures from taking hold before they harden.
cues.zh: 在這些文化成形、僵化之前， 就阻止它們蔓延。

cues.text: And what I've learned is this.
cues.en: And what I've learned is this.
cues.zh: 以下是我所學到的。

cues.text: First, bullying is not conflict.
cues.en: First, bullying is not conflict.
cues.zh: 首先，霸凌不是衝突。

cues.text: It's not a debate,
cues.en: It's not a debate,
cues.zh: 它不是辯論，

cues.text: it's not criticism,
cues.en: it's not criticism,
cues.zh: 不是批評，

cues.text: it's not humor that you're too sensitive to take well.
cues.en: it's not humor that you're too sensitive to take well.
cues.zh: 也不是你太敏感、 才承受不了的玩笑。

cues.text: It is a deliberately targeted,
cues.en: It is a deliberately targeted,
cues.zh: 霸凌是由多人刻意針對一個人，

cues.text: serial, escalating pattern of attacks
cues.en: serial, escalating pattern of attacks
cues.zh: 一次又一次發動愈演愈烈的攻擊，

cues.text: carried out by multiple people,
cues.en: carried out by multiple people,
cues.zh: 一次又一次發動愈演愈烈的攻擊，

cues.text: and it's intended to destroy a person's reputation
cues.en: and it's intended to destroy a person's reputation
cues.zh: 目的就是摧毀那個人的聲譽，

cues.text: and their ability to contribute.
cues.en: and their ability to contribute.
cues.zh: 以及他為群體做出貢獻的能力。

cues.text: It unfolds in predictable stages.
cues.en: It unfolds in predictable stages.
cues.zh: 霸凌依循可預測的階段一步步發展。

cues.text: And it usually ends with someone being completely silenced
cues.en: And it usually ends with someone being completely silenced
cues.zh: 而結局通常就是讓某個人徹底噤聲，

cues.text: or disappearing completely.
cues.en: or disappearing completely.
cues.zh: 或者徹底消失。

cues.text: This is really important.
cues.en: This is really important.
cues.zh: 這一點非常重要。

cues.text: Bullies are rare.
cues.en: Bullies are rare.
cues.zh: 霸凌者是少數。

cues.text: They're rare.
cues.en: They're rare.
cues.zh: 他們是少數。

cues.text: Most of us are not bullies.
cues.en: Most of us are not bullies.
cues.zh: 我們大多數人都不是霸凌者。

cues.text: Bullies share one thing:
cues.en: Bullies share one thing:
cues.zh: 霸凌者有一個共同點：

cues.text: a worldview.
cues.en: a worldview.
cues.zh: 他們有一套特定的世界觀。

cues.text: In their worldview,
cues.en: In their worldview,
cues.zh: 在他們的世界裡，

cues.text: the world is hostile,
cues.en: the world is hostile,
cues.zh: 世界充滿敵意，

cues.text: people are fundamentally bad,
cues.en: people are fundamentally bad,
cues.zh: 人性本惡，

cues.text: everything of value is scarce,
cues.en: everything of value is scarce,
cues.zh: 有價值的東西都是稀缺的，

cues.text: it’s all zero-sum.
cues.en: it’s all zero-sum.
cues.zh: 樣樣都是零和遊戲。

cues.text: Your achievement is their loss.
cues.en: Your achievement is their loss.
cues.zh: 你的成就，就是他們的損失。

cues.text: They have an insatiable need for recognition and status and dominance,
cues.en: They have an insatiable need for recognition and status and dominance,
cues.zh: 他們對認可、地位和主導優勢 有著永遠無法滿足的渴望，

cues.text: and they prove their dominance
cues.en: and they prove their dominance
cues.zh: 而他們證明自己具有主導地位的方式，

cues.text: by publicly demonstrating that they can force a target,
cues.en: by publicly demonstrating that they can force a target,
cues.zh: 就是公開展示自己能迫使一個目標——

cues.text: a valuable target, to fully submit.
cues.en: a valuable target, to fully submit.
cues.zh: 有價值的目標——完全屈服。

cues.text: That's what bullying is.
cues.en: That's what bullying is.
cues.zh: 這就是霸凌的本質。

cues.text: Bullying has been on the rise among adults for the last 15 years.
cues.en: Bullying has been on the rise among adults for the last 15 years.
cues.zh: 過去 15 年來， 成人間的霸凌現象與日俱增。

cues.text: Digital platforms make bullying faster, easier, louder.
cues.en: Digital platforms make bullying faster, easier, louder.
cues.zh: 數位平臺讓霸凌變得更快、 更容易，聲勢也更浩大。

cues.text: And the bullies' lies last forever now.
cues.en: And the bullies' lies last forever now.
cues.zh: 如今，霸凌者散播的謊言 甚至可以永遠留存。

cues.text: So ...
cues.en: So ...
cues.zh: 那麼……

cues.text: What do we do?
cues.en: What do we do?
cues.zh: 我們該怎麼辦？

cues.text: The first thing to understand is that bullies need us.
cues.en: The first thing to understand is that bullies need us.
cues.zh: 首先，我們必須明白， 霸凌者需要我們。

cues.text: Bullies need an audience.
cues.en: Bullies need an audience.
cues.zh: 霸凌者需要觀眾。

cues.text: They need people to carry out their agenda.
cues.en: They need people to carry out their agenda.
cues.zh: 他們需要有人替他們達成目的。

cues.text: When we just watch and remain silent,
cues.en: When we just watch and remain silent,
cues.zh: 當我們袖手旁觀、保持沉默時，

cues.text: we're what I call passive bystanders.
cues.en: we're what I call passive bystanders.
cues.zh: 我們就成為所謂的「被動旁觀者」。

cues.text: When we join in and amplify and share an attack,
cues.en: When we join in and amplify and share an attack,
cues.zh: 當我們加入其中， 助紂為虐、轉傳攻擊時，

cues.text: we're what I call accessory bullies.
cues.en: we're what I call accessory bullies.
cues.zh: 我們就成了「霸凌的幫兇」。

cues.text: But if we refuse our participation,
cues.en: But if we refuse our participation,
cues.zh: 但如果我們拒絕參與，

cues.text: a lone bully is impotent.
cues.en: a lone bully is impotent.
cues.zh: 孤立的霸凌者就無能為力。

cues.text: Without us, a bully is impotent.
cues.en: Without us, a bully is impotent.
cues.zh: 沒有我們，霸凌者就無能為力。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）

cues.text: Second, we need to learn to spot the opening.
cues.en: Second, we need to learn to spot the opening.
cues.zh: 第二，我們要學會察覺介入的時機。

cues.text: When we get in early,
cues.en: When we get in early,
cues.zh: 如果我們及早介入，

cues.text: we can totally derail this.
cues.en: we can totally derail this.
cues.zh: 就能徹底阻撓霸凌的程序。

cues.text: It starts with what I call a “bully test.”
cues.en: It starts with what I call a “bully test.”
cues.zh: 事情往往從我所謂的 「霸凌測試」開始。

cues.text: The bully tests the audience to see if they can get away
cues.en: The bully tests the audience to see if they can get away
cues.zh: 霸凌者會先試探旁觀者，

cues.text: with bullying that person.
cues.en: with bullying that person.
cues.zh: 可能是在專業場合 說出非常不恰當的話，

cues.text: It might be a really inappropriate comment in a professional setting,
cues.en: It might be a really inappropriate comment in a professional setting,
cues.zh: 可能是在專業場合 說出非常不恰當的話，

cues.text: or it might be an accusation
cues.en: or it might be an accusation
cues.zh: 也可能是對某人提出 足以摧毀其聲譽的指控，

cues.text: against someone that’s reputation-destroying,
cues.en: against someone that’s reputation-destroying,
cues.zh: 卻沒有任何證據支援。

cues.text: but not backed by evidence.
cues.en: but not backed by evidence.
cues.zh: 卻沒有任何證據支援。

cues.text: When we hear those things and we stay silent or we laugh,
cues.en: When we hear those things and we stay silent or we laugh,
cues.zh: 當我們聽到這些話， 卻保持沉默，甚至跟著笑，

cues.text: we're just saying to the bully, "Go forward."
cues.en: we're just saying to the bully, "Go forward."
cues.zh: 我們其實就是在 對霸凌者說：「繼續。」

cues.text: And that's when they launch their attack.
cues.en: And that's when they launch their attack.
cues.zh: 而這時，他們就會發動攻擊。

cues.text: We also need to practice social bravery.
cues.en: We also need to practice social bravery.
cues.zh: 我們還需要培養所謂的「社會勇氣」。

cues.text: These small risks that we take to defend each other,
cues.en: These small risks that we take to defend each other,
cues.zh: 也就是在人際相處時， 願意冒一點小小的風險，

cues.text: to support each other interpersonally.
cues.en: to support each other interpersonally.
cues.zh: 為彼此挺身而出、支援彼此。

cues.text: And social bravery is risky.
cues.en: And social bravery is risky.
cues.zh: 而社會勇氣確實伴隨風險。

cues.text: So we need to distribute the risk across people.
cues.en: So we need to distribute the risk across people.
cues.zh: 所以，我們需要讓更多人 共同承擔這個風險。

cues.text: We need to do it together.
cues.en: We need to do it together.
cues.zh: 我們需要一起做。

cues.text: It is so much easier for two people to do it
cues.en: It is so much easier for two people to do it
cues.zh: 兩個人一起做， 要比一個人單獨做容易得多。

cues.text: than for one person to do it.
cues.en: than for one person to do it.
cues.zh: 當一名旁觀者以明確、 顯著的方式挺身而出，

cues.text: When one bystander steps in, in a way that’s noticeable,
cues.en: When one bystander steps in, in a way that’s noticeable,
cues.zh: 當一名旁觀者以明確、 顯著的方式挺身而出，

cues.text: others step in.
cues.en: others step in.
cues.zh: 其他人也會跟著站出來。

cues.text: And we know from research on changing social conventions
cues.en: And we know from research on changing social conventions
cues.zh: 從改變社會規範的研究中，我們知道，

cues.text: that when about 25 percent of people step in,
cues.en: that when about 25 percent of people step in,
cues.zh: 當大約 25% 的人願意挺身而出，

cues.text: they can flip a social norm completely.
cues.en: they can flip a social norm completely.
cues.zh: 就能徹底扭轉一項社會規範。

cues.text: Bullying is not a personal problem.
cues.en: Bullying is not a personal problem.
cues.zh: 霸凌不是個人的問題，

cues.text: It's a collective problem.
cues.en: It's a collective problem.
cues.zh: 而是集體的問題。

cues.text: And we can fix it.
cues.en: And we can fix it.
cues.zh: 我們可以解決。

cues.text: So after eight years of writing this book,
cues.en: So after eight years of writing this book,
cues.zh: 花了八年寫完這本書後，

cues.text: I turned it in a few months ago.
cues.en: I turned it in a few months ago.
cues.zh: 我幾個月前把稿子交了出去。

cues.text: Right after that,
cues.en: Right after that,
cues.zh: 緊接著，

cues.text: I traveled to Greeley, Colorado,
cues.en: I traveled to Greeley, Colorado,
cues.zh: 我前往科羅拉多州的格里利，

cues.text: a small city in the High Plains
cues.en: a small city in the High Plains
cues.zh: 一座位於高地平原地區的小城市。

cues.text: that was raw,
cues.en: that was raw,
cues.zh: 當時那裡氣氛緊繃、

cues.text: politically divided, on edge.
cues.en: politically divided, on edge.
cues.zh: 政治立場分裂，劍拔弩張。

cues.text: I could feel the vigilance in the air when I looked at them.
cues.en: I could feel the vigilance in the air when I looked at them.
cues.zh: 我看著聽眾，就能感受到 現場瀰漫著戒備的氣氛。

cues.text: I spoke about personal power and trust,
cues.en: I spoke about personal power and trust,
cues.zh: 我談到個人力量與信任，

cues.text: and at the end the moderator said her last question to me was this.
cues.en: and at the end the moderator said her last question to me was this.
cues.zh: 最後，主持人問我一個問題。

cues.text: She said,
cues.en: She said,
cues.zh: 她說：

cues.text: "Is there one piece of leadership advice
cues.en: "Is there one piece of leadership advice
cues.zh: 「能不能給我們一項你從未分享過的

cues.text: that you haven't really shared?"
cues.en: that you haven't really shared?"
cues.zh: 有關領導力的建議？」

cues.text: And I said, “Yeah.
cues.en: And I said, “Yeah.
cues.zh: 我說：「好的。

cues.text: We'll never win by bullying the bullies.
cues.en: We'll never win by bullying the bullies.
cues.zh: 我們永遠不可能靠霸凌霸凌者來獲勝。

cues.text: We cannot validate their worldview.
cues.en: We cannot validate their worldview.
cues.zh: 我們不能認可他們的世界觀是對的。

cues.text: As soon as we tell them that the world has to be brutal,
cues.en: As soon as we tell them that the world has to be brutal,
cues.zh: 因為一旦我們告訴他們， 這個世界本來就必須如此殘酷，

cues.text: they say, ’See?
cues.en: they say, ’See?
cues.zh: 他們就會說：『你看吧？

cues.text: That’s why I have to behave this way.“’
cues.en: That’s why I have to behave this way.“’
cues.zh: 所以我才得這樣做。』」

cues.text: I told them you don’t have to show how much you can hate
cues.en: I told them you don’t have to show how much you can hate
cues.zh: 我告訴他們，你不需要展現 自己有多恨一個人，

cues.text: to prove how much you care, or to prove that you belong.
cues.en: to prove how much you care, or to prove that you belong.
cues.zh: 才能證明你有多在乎，

cues.text: And I looked out and I saw their shoulders relax.
cues.en: And I looked out and I saw their shoulders relax.
cues.zh: 我看向臺下，看見聽眾的肩膀 放鬆了下來。

cues.text: I saw a flicker of hope in their faces.
cues.en: I saw a flicker of hope in their faces.
cues.zh: 我看見他們臉上閃過一絲希望。

cues.text: I felt them collectively exhale.
cues.en: I felt them collectively exhale.
cues.zh: 我感覺到他們一起鬆了一口氣。

cues.text: And the next day a woman wrote to me.
cues.en: And the next day a woman wrote to me.
cues.zh: 第二天，一位女士寫信給我。

cues.text: And she said, "I was at your talk.
cues.en: And she said, "I was at your talk.
cues.zh: 她說：「我當時在現場聽你的演講。

cues.text: And I noticed something interesting as I left the venue.
cues.en: And I noticed something interesting as I left the venue.
cues.zh: 離開會場時，我注意到 一件很有意思的事。

cues.text: The crowd was unusually cheerful and courteous.
cues.en: The crowd was unusually cheerful and courteous.
cues.zh: 群眾異常地愉快，也特別有禮貌。

cues.text: Several drive aisles wove together toward the exits,
cues.en: Several drive aisles wove together toward the exits,
cues.zh: 好幾條車道交織著通往出口，

cues.text: and everyone was alternating and letting each other in.
cues.en: and everyone was alternating and letting each other in.
cues.zh: 而每個人都輪流讓對方先走。

cues.text: No one was saying with their actions
cues.en: No one was saying with their actions
cues.zh: 沒有人用行動表現出 「我比別人重要」。

cues.text: that they were more important than another person.
cues.en: that they were more important than another person.
cues.zh: 沒有人用行動表現出 「我比別人重要」。

cues.text: I just wanted to share the observation
cues.en: I just wanted to share the observation
cues.zh: 我只是想告訴你，我觀察到：

cues.text: that you made an immediate, positive and tangible difference."
cues.en: that you made an immediate, positive and tangible difference."
cues.zh: 你的演講帶來了立即、 正面而具體的改變。」

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）

cues.text: We want to be neighbors again.
cues.en: We want to be neighbors again.
cues.zh: 我們想重新成為鄰居。

cues.text: We want to go to our kids' friends' birthday parties
cues.en: We want to go to our kids' friends' birthday parties
cues.zh: 我們想去參加孩子朋友的生日派對，

cues.text: and not worry about an explosion.
cues.en: and not worry about an explosion.
cues.zh: 而不用擔心現場突然爆發衝突。

cues.text: We don't want to have to show how much we hate
cues.en: We don't want to have to show how much we hate
cues.zh: 我們不想再需要展現自己有多恨，

cues.text: to prove how much we care.
cues.en: to prove how much we care.
cues.zh: 才能證明自己有多在乎。

cues.text: Bullies' power is borrowed power.
cues.en: Bullies' power is borrowed power.
cues.zh: 霸凌者的力量，是借來的力量。

cues.text: And we can refuse to give it to them.
cues.en: And we can refuse to give it to them.
cues.zh: 而我們可以拒絕把這份力量借給他們。

cues.text: We all have access to personal power, and with that personal power,
cues.en: We all have access to personal power, and with that personal power,
cues.zh: 我們每個人都擁有 運用個人力量的能力，

cues.text: we can commit small acts of social bravery,
cues.en: we can commit small acts of social bravery,
cues.zh: 而憑藉這份個人力量，我們可以 做出一個個小小的社會勇敢行動，

cues.text: supporting each other,
cues.en: supporting each other,
cues.zh: 彼此支援，

cues.text: challenging bullies.
cues.en: challenging bullies.
cues.zh: 向霸凌者提出挑戰。

cues.text: So I invite you please, to join me.
cues.en: So I invite you please, to join me.
cues.zh: 我想邀請你，請加入我。

cues.text: Let's find that collective power
cues.en: Let's find that collective power
cues.zh: 讓我們找到這股集體的力量，

cues.text: and turn bullying around.
cues.en: and turn bullying around.
cues.zh: 扭轉霸凌的局面。

cues.text: And one more thing.
cues.en: And one more thing.
cues.zh: 還有一件事。

cues.text: (Cheers and applause)
cues.en: (Cheers and applause)
cues.zh: （歡呼與掌聲）

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝你們。

cues.text: Thank you so much.
cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）
